detail.longDescription: What are the office hours of an AI agent? Agents are attractive for infrastructure work partly because they have none. But what is one allowed to do at 3 a.m. when nobody is there to stop it? Our first answer in the lab was wrong; the one that held is that permissions depend on the operation and the identity, never on the hour. A research note with sources and three nights from our lab: https:// meho-ai.hashnode.dev/what-are- the-office-hours-of-an-ai-agent # AIAgents # DevOps # Kubernetes
